shots.name: 01-take-order
shots.caption: A free table has nothing to read, so tapping it goes straight to ＋ Take order — the dish builder.

shots.name: 02-waiting
shots.caption: A guest's order has landed. It is ONE amber line, not on the bill yet: what came, what it costs, ✓ Accept, ✕.

shots.name: 03-accept-detail
shots.caption: Tap that line and the incoming ticket opens dish by dish — quantities, money, what to avoid in every dish — with Cancel and Accept at the end.

shots.name: 04-accepted
shots.caption: Accepted. Its dishes are now on the bill, in their menu place, and the amber line is gone.

shots.name: 05-full-bill
shots.caption: The whole bill: 20 dish lines, one per dish, in the menu's own order. The same dish from two tickets is one line, with a small 2⟩ saying so.

shots.name: 06-served-sinks
shots.caption: Served dishes sink to the bottom and go quiet, so the top of the list is only what is still to come.

shots.name: 07-dish-sheet
shots.caption: A dish's own detail: its course, its total, and one row per ticket it came on — each with its own Serve, ✎, quantity, remove and void.

shots.name: 08-dish-edit
shots.caption: ✎ on any line: allergens to avoid and the kitchen note for that one dish.

shots.name: 09-kot-wise
shots.caption: The same bill, ticket by ticket. No headings here either: the ticket is on the line, and a hairline shows where one ends.

shots.name: 10-calls
shots.caption: Six calls ringing at once, on one line. Each emoji is the button that clears it; all ✓ clears the lot.

shots.name: 11-tag-family
shots.caption: Marked Family — the mark sits in the head, and the party chip beside it.

shots.name: 14-discount
shots.caption: A discount on the bill: the money line carries it, and the total is what is due.

shots.name: 15-all-served
shots.caption: Everything is out. The bar is full, every line is quiet, and the only thing left is the money.

shots.name: 16-phone
shots.caption: The same popup on a phone (392 × 844) — the identical thing, edge to edge.

shots.name: 17-short-window
shots.caption: A short window: the rows shrink to fit rather than scroll, and the progress legend is dropped before the dishes are.
